cases.question: Are Xero prices in Australia stated in AUD and do they include GST?
cases.expectedBehaviour: Answer from the Australian pricing source with at least one validated citation.

relevantEvidence.supportingText: Track time and costs for projects For 10 users$7 per additional user $7 per additional user NewBenchmark against the industry New Pricing plan details and offer terms Prices are in AUD and include GST. Xero reserves the right to change pricing at any time. Xero subscriptions auto-renew monthly until they are cancelled. If you later decide to change to a less expensive plan you can do so 1 month after upgrading. If you select a plan which includes Payroll, Expenses, or Projects, additional charges may apply if you go over the stated included number of users (Expenses and Projects) or people paid (Payroll). Your invited users who have access to those features may trigger additional charges on your subscription if the included usage/number of users/people paid are exceeded.

actualOutput.answer: Yes, Xero prices for Australia are stated in AUD and include GST [E1].

actualOutput.answer: In Australia, Xero supports small businesses by offering tools to automate administrative tasks, manage invoices and quotes, track expenses and inventory, process payroll, and enable online collaboration with accountants or bookkeepers [E2, E4, E5]. Additionally, small businesses can use the Xero mobile app for accounting on the go [E2, E5]. For accountants and bookkeepers, Xero provides a partner program that offers free access to accounting software for managing their practice, resources for client support, and practice management tools [E1, E3, E4]. Partners can also access specialist advice, gain eligibility for client subscription discounts, and use the Xero Partner Hub to manage staff and workflows [E1, E4].
